career55.sapsf.eu/career?company=bankofcypr is a JS Career-Site-Builder shell; no public JSON/RSS feed.
nlb.csod.com search needs a JWT bearer token extracted from the rendered page (POST /services/x/career-site).
careers.eurobank.gr renders jobs via JavaScript (bare GET returns 0).
